topic: Explosive train, inherent safeties in aircraft weapons while carried on aircraft.
syllabus_extract: Explosive train, inherent safeties in aircraft weapons while carried on aircraft. Various types of conventional weapons including guided weapons
specific_objectives: 3.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate various armaments carried by naval aircrafts

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of weapon safety diagrams and explosive train components from IB/PDF; Instructor supervision required for safety protocol verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an explosive train?
List three types of conventional weapons carried by naval aircraft.
Define inherent safety in the context of aircraft weapons.

topics: Definition and function of explosive train
development.content:
Definition and function of explosive train
Components of explosive train
Initiation sequence of explosive train
Inherent safeties during carriage
Safety mechanisms for guided weapons

High explosive bomb characteristics
Missile and rocket safety features
Torpedo and depth charge handling
A/C gun ammunition safety
Guided weapon carriage protocols

Review of weapon armament types
Summary of inherent safety systems
Comparison of conventional vs guided
Safety procedures for maintenance
Preparation for next lesson topics

summary_questions: Explain how inherent safeties prevent accidental detonation during carriage.
Differentiate between the explosive train of a bomb and a missile.
Identify two key safety features specific to guided weapons.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between High Explosive Bombs and Missiles as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 04).
